20180.long_desc:
A professional 29inch LCD Monitor designed for arcade machines and retro game enthusiasts. This monitor offers a 4:3 viewing aspect ratio with RGB/VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort inputs and supports 15khz/24khz/31khz, and high definition up to 1600x1200 UXGA resolution. Highly suitable also for digital display and PC desktop with advanced features. ARCADE MACHINE & GAMING INDUSTRY
  • supports multiple variations of 15khz, 25kz, 31khz, arcade gaming resolutions.
  • latest firmware, over 10 years of constant firmware upgrades offering the widest possible support for most arcade game boards on "plug and play basis". From Sega Model 2 and 3 game boards, to Neo Geo, Namco System 256, Sega Triforce and your standard JAMMA arcade game boards.
  • auto picture function that works, tuned with real arcade game boards. Just press the auto button for perfect centering of your arcade picture.
  • multiple mounting options including angle brackets (included) rear mounting connection, and VESA mount. This offers the widest mounting options.
  • breakout OSD monitor control board (optional). Mount the monitor adjustment board where it matters, in front of you.
  • RGB adapter PCB (optional) for plug and play with almost any CRT tube monitor wiring. This board also offers fine tuning of color via red,blue,green color potentiometers
  • full angle viewing is perfect for all arcade machines.
  • multiple screen adjustments including picture rotate function.
    • PLEASE NOTE: This is a viewable 29inch 4:3 Ratio LCD monitor and maybe too large for your arcade machine - our 26inch 4:3 ratio monitor maybe more suitable. 29inch CRT tube monitors often have a "view size" of 27 to 28inches. Please measure your machines bezel view size and then compare against our monitor sizes (check the screenshots of each Arcooda monitor which shows all dimensions including viewing size). HOME RETRO & PC GAMING
  • over 160 pre-programmed PC input modes including 240p, 480p, 720p, up to 1600x1200
  • offering full display angle viewing with 16.7M color reproduction, 1200:1 contrast ratio
  • VESA mounting for easy desktop mounting
  • connect breakout speakers via the 3.5mm audio jack
  • remote control function (optional)
    • DIGITAL DISPLAY & DESKTOP PC
  • Extend Mode via DisplayPort Multi-stream (MST): Our 29inch LCD monitor has both a DisplayPort input and a dedicated DisplayPort output port, so that you can connect them in a series. One cable from your PC can run multiple monitors.
  • Mirror Clone Mode: via MST, show one image on multiple monitors
  • Extended Mode: via MST, your PC can run multiple monitors showing different screens
  • Picture in Picture is supported with variable screen options.
  • Split Screen functions include top/bottom split, left/right split, and 4 way screen splitting.
  • connect breakout speakers via the 3.5mm audio jack
    • Whilst the Arcooda 29inch 4:3 ratio LCD monitor has been designed for the arcade machine industry, it is highly suitable for other industries including industrial control systems, military, digital media including photography and videography. Features include;
  • 1x RGB/VGA Input
  • 2x DVI Inputs
  • 2x HDMI Inputs
  • 3x DisplayPort Inputs
  • Freesync, DDCCI, UltraVivid, plus other monitor display settings
